name: tududi
description: Tasks, projects and notes organised by areas, with a Telegram bot

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database with every task, note and user, and secrets.env with this install's own session secret and database password. Back it up.

paths.name: Uploads
paths.description: Attachments, avatars and project images. Back it up.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Backups you make in tududi's settings.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: tududi web UI, API and CalDAV, published on host as 6763

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: TUDUDI_USER_EMAIL
variables.description: The email of the first account. Only used while tududi has no users yet.

variables.name: TUDUDI_USER_PASSWORD
variables.description: The first account's password. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Change it later in tududi itself.
